method.operation: Read fixed tar member; verify tarball SHA512 against registry; evaluate inspected no-import module and invoke on eight synthetic strings with per-evaluation timeout. No npm installation, lifecycle script, editor integration or external text supplied.

staticFindings: Module contains an irregular participle list and a case-insensitive be-plus-immediate-participle regex.
Module has no require/import or direct filesystem/network/output calls; it returns numeric index/offset spans. This observation is only about these inspected module bytes.
Optional by mode requires by immediately after the match. Fixed write-good main calls fn(text) without forwarding this option.
Developer tests cover simple regular/irregular passives, line breaks, indeed exception and by option; they do not establish broad linguistic accuracy.
